hostIdentityFollowUp.trustSource: Read-only local r7-server /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub. No private-key or credential access. ssh-keygen reports SHA256:4u6yOFA9tIp5zTHhMASbwsDVtWAKX7JyYidkJq6PDKE; one bounded public ED25519 scan of ssh.mendola.tech returns the exact same public key. The local file supplies trust; a scan alone does not.

Document fail-closed mismatch handling and out-of-band reviewed rotation; no host-key, secret or server configuration mutation.

Operator documentation distinguishes workflow admission guards from repository branch/workflow protection, authorized dispatchers and runner administration. No credentials, service configuration, DNS, repository settings or SSH host identity changed.
